info.title: LedgerPay API
info.description: A small LKR digital wallet with a double-entry ledger. Sign in at /api/v1/auth/login, then send the token as a Bearer token. Errors use RFC 7807 Problem Details with a stable code.

get.summary: The audit log, newest first, by action, by who acted and from and to (whole days in UTC, both included). Admins only.

401.description: No token, or the token is expired or not valid. Code UNAUTHENTICATED.

403.description: The signed-in user's role is not allowed here. Code FORBIDDEN.

429.description: Too many requests. Wait for the number of seconds in the Retry-After header. Code RATE_LIMITED.

get.summary: The operator and admin accounts, with whether each is restricted. Admins only.

401.description: No token, or the token is expired or not valid. Code UNAUTHENTICATED.

403.description: The signed-in user's role is not allowed here. Code FORBIDDEN.

429.description: Too many requests. Wait for the number of seconds in the Retry-After header. Code RATE_LIMITED.

patch.summary: Restrict an operator account, or lift the restriction, with a reason. A restricted operator cannot sign in, their sessions end at once and their token stops working. Admins only.

401.description: No token, or the token is expired or not valid. Code UNAUTHENTICATED.

403.description: The signed-in user's role is not allowed here. Code FORBIDDEN.

429.description: Too many requests. Wait for the number of seconds in the Retry-After header. Code RATE_LIMITED.

post.summary: Credit a customer wallet after a bank deposit. The bank reference can be used once. Operators only. Needs an Idempotency-Key header.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A new value for each money move, up to 100 characters from A-Z, a-z, 0-9, _ and -. Sending the same key and body again gives the first answer. The same key with another body gives 409.

401.description: No token, or the token is expired or not valid. Code UNAUTHENTICATED.

403.description: The signed-in user's role is not allowed here. Code FORBIDDEN.

429.description: Too many requests. Wait for the number of seconds in the Retry-After header. Code RATE_LIMITED.

get.summary: Every transaction, newest first, with type, status, wallet number and from and to (whole days in UTC, both included). Operators and admins only.

401.description: No token, or the token is expired or not valid. Code UNAUTHENTICATED.

403.description: The signed-in user's role is not allowed here. Code FORBIDDEN.

429.description: Too many requests. Wait for the number of seconds in the Retry-After header. Code RATE_LIMITED.

get.summary: Find customers by part of a name, an email, a mobile number or a wallet number, and by whether the wallet is frozen or the account locked. Operators and admins only.

401.description: No token, or the token is expired or not valid. Code UNAUTHENTICATED.

403.description: The signed-in user's role is not allowed here. Code FORBIDDEN.

429.description: Too many requests. Wait for the number of seconds in the Retry-After header. Code RATE_LIMITED.

get.summary: One customer with the freeze reason and the latest transactions. Looking is written to the audit log. Operators and admins only.

401.description: No token, or the token is expired or not valid. Code UNAUTHENTICATED.

403.description: The signed-in user's role is not allowed here. Code FORBIDDEN.

429.description: Too many requests. Wait for the number of seconds in the Retry-After header. Code RATE_LIMITED.

patch.summary: Freeze or unfreeze a wallet, with a reason. Operators and admins only.

401.description: No token, or the token is expired or not valid. Code UNAUTHENTICATED.

403.description: The signed-in user's role is not allowed here. Code FORBIDDEN.

post.summary: Create a customer account with an empty wallet. Anyone may call it.

429.description: Too many requests. Wait for the number of seconds in the Retry-After header. Code RATE_LIMITED.

post.summary: Sign in and get an access token that lasts 15 minutes. The refresh token is set as an HttpOnly cookie. Anyone may call it.

429.description: Too many requests. Wait for the number of seconds in the Retry-After header. Code RATE_LIMITED.

post.summary: Swap the refresh cookie for a new access token and a new cookie. Anyone with a cookie may call it.

429.description: Too many requests. Wait for the number of seconds in the Retry-After header. Code RATE_LIMITED.

post.summary: End the session of the refresh cookie and remove the cookie. Always answers 204.

429.description: Too many requests. Wait for the number of seconds in the Retry-After header. Code RATE_LIMITED.

get.summary: My signed-in sessions, newest first, with the one of this browser marked. Any signed-in user.

429.description: Too many requests. Wait for the number of seconds in the Retry-After header. Code RATE_LIMITED.

delete.summary: Sign out one of my sessions. Any signed-in user, for their own sessions only.

429.description: Too many requests. Wait for the number of seconds in the Retry-After header. Code RATE_LIMITED.

get.summary: Show one transaction. Its sender and receiver see it, and so do operators and admins. Anyone else gets 404, the same as for a reference that does not exist.

401.description: No token, or the token is expired or not valid. Code UNAUTHENTICATED.

get.summary: Show the fee and the total for an amount, before sending. Customers only.

401.description: No token, or the token is expired or not valid. Code UNAUTHENTICATED.

403.description: The signed-in user's role is not allowed here. Code FORBIDDEN.

429.description: Too many requests. Wait for the number of seconds in the Retry-After header. Code RATE_LIMITED.

post.summary: Send money to another active wallet, by wallet number or mobile number. The fee is charged to the sender. Needs an Idempotency-Key header.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A new value for each money move, up to 100 characters from A-Z, a-z, 0-9, _ and -. Sending the same key and body again gives the first answer. The same key with another body gives 409.

get.summary: Show my wallet number, balance and status. Customers only.

403.description: The signed-in user's role is not allowed here. Code FORBIDDEN.

get.summary: Find a wallet by wallet number or mobile number before sending. Shows the number, a masked name and whether it is active. Customers only.

401.description: No token, or the token is expired or not valid. Code UNAUTHENTICATED.

429.description: Too many requests. Wait for the number of seconds in the Retry-After header. Code RATE_LIMITED.

get.summary: My transaction history, newest first, with page, pageSize, from and to (whole days in UTC, both included). Customers only.

403.description: The signed-in user's role is not allowed here. Code FORBIDDEN.

get.summary: Answers Healthy when the API can reach its database and Unhealthy when it cannot. No token needed.

Bearer.description: The access token from /api/v1/auth/login. It lasts 15 minutes.
